title: 云依助手 0.13.0
releaseNotes: Adds desktop-only Serial, MQTT 3.1.1 and Modbus RTU/TCP debugging tools, bringing the built-in catalog to 20 tools. Includes fixed scrolling message views, text/HEX data, serial line endings and repeat send, MQTT QoS 0/1/2 and validated TLS, and Modbus register tables with per-operation write confirmation. Sessions stop when leaving the tool or closing the workbench. MQTT uses Clean Session and never persists passwords. The independent web catalog is unchanged.
